stem: Which graph best represents a quadratic function that has only one zero?

options.label: A
options.text: [Graph with vertex below x-axis and crossing x-axis twice]

options.label: B
options.text: [Graph with vertex above x-axis and not crossing x-axis]

options.label: C
options.text: [Graph with vertex on the x-axis and only touches x-axis once]

options.label: D
options.text: [Graph with vertex above x-axis and not crossing x-axis]

visual_elements: Graph A: downward parabola crossing the x-axis twice.
Graph B: upward parabola with vertex above x-axis, no x-intercepts.
Graph C: upward parabola with vertex on the x-axis, tangent at one point.
Graph D: upward parabola with vertex above x-axis, no x-intercepts.
notes: Answer option C shows a quadratic function with exactly one zero, where the parabola touches the x-axis at a single point.
